Name: Leah new look (Seasonal.Festivals)
Author: pinzol
Description:
[b][color=#ffff00][size=5]UPDATED FOR 1.6 + SEASONAL OUTFITS + FESTIVALS + BONUS FURNITURE
[/size][/color][/b]
A completely new look for Leah. I always felt that even if she came to live in the woods ([size=1][i]what a dream[/i][/size]), she'd still have her city outfits with her. So jeans, plaid shirts and sweaters with jackets it is for her now. I hope you guys will like this version of Leah too.

[img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/6306/6306-1717869753-306730636.gif[/img]

[list]
[*]Now the mod has[b] Seasonal outfits[/b] (in spring and winter Leah wears her Indoors outfit).
[*]Added [b]Festival outfits [/b](based on Cute Outfits festival designs).
[*]Added a new [b]summer outfit with her hair up[/b]. She'll wear this outfit and hairstyle (without glasses and with shorts instead of jeans) to aerobics if you've got my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6573]Harvey[/url]﻿ mod and his Aerobics Day config is ON. She'll also appear in it in Harvey's 6-heart event (Only with [b]Leah New Look 1.6[/b] [b]FULL[/b] version of the mod!).
[*]Added a small [b]bonus furniture pack.[/b] You'll start recieving decor and furniture from it after Leah's 8-heart event (Read more under "How to get furniture").
[*]A few extra rugs from the new furniture pack are available from the Furniture catalogue at any given moment.
[*]You can use edited versions of Leah's[b] spouse room and cabin[/b]. 
[*]Added 2 new [b]schedule points[/b]: 
[/list] ﻿ ﻿- on Mondays after visiting Pierre's store Leah will be seen drawing somewhere around the Stardrop Saloon,
﻿ ﻿- In Winter (Tue, Thu, Sat) Leah will be drawing nearby the Adventurer's Guild.

[b][color=#b4a7d6][size=4]How to get the furniture:[/size][/color][/b]
[spoiler]
1. Have  [b]Leah New Look 1.6[/b] [b]FULL [/b]version of the mod installed. You'll have to install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url]  as well to make it work.

2. After you've seen Leah's 8-heart event (be it Art Show or Art Web site event), you'll receive mail from her with a thanks for supporting her and a first piece of furniture - a painting in 2 sizes.

3. After that you'll be receiving one item per season from her for the next year. You'll get 6 in total through mail: a painting (2 sizes), a rug, a statue, a vase with flowers that change every season and a simple but nice double bed.

4. Everytime you receive a new piece of furniture or decor it becomes available for purchase at the [b]Traveling Cart:[/b]
[b] - Painting (2 sizes) [/b]in Cindersnap Forest[b] [/b]on Fridays and Sundays,
﻿- [b]Spring Rug (2 sizes)[/b] at the Desert Festival,
﻿- [b]Seasonal Flower Vase[/b] at the Desert Festival as well,
﻿﻿- [b]Mermaid Statue[/b] and Blob Statue? at the Night Market,
﻿- and [b]Double Fish Bed [/b]at the Festival of Ice

5. You can buy A Simple Rug (which is a recolour of Leah's Spring Rug) from the standard Furniture catalogue at any time. It comes it two sizes and 3 colours.
-------
[color=#00ff00][b]There may be some troubles with triggering that first mail from Leah:
[/b][/color]
1. If you're absolutely sure you've seen her 8-heart event, but that mail with paintings is still nowhere to be seen, use this debug command ([url=https://stardewcommunitywiki.com/Modding:Debug_commands#Entering_debug_commands]how to enter commands[/url]): 

[b]debug mailfortomorrow Leah1
[/b]
You should receive the letter next morning

2. For possible future updates: you've updated the mod itself but the furniture is still the same/is not updated, then use this debug command:

[b]reload_furniture_pack pinzol.LeahFurniture[/b]

And restart the game, just to be sure.

[/spoiler]
-------------------------------------------------
[color=#ffff00][b]How to install:[/b][/color]
[list]
[*]Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content patcher[/url]﻿ installed
[*]Have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url]﻿ installed if you're planning to use additional furniture I included.
[*]Download a version of the mod you prefer. There are currently 2 versions available (use only one at a time!):
[/list] ﻿﻿- [b]Leah New Look 1.6[/b] [b]FULL[/b] (Full pack: Seasonal and Festival outfits, New Furniture, new schedule points, edited rooms),
﻿ ﻿- [b]Leah New Look 1.6 LITE[/b] (Only seasonal and festival outfits and edited rooms that you can turn off)
[list]
[*]Unzip the  folder inside the archive into your Mods folder.
[*]Highly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] by spacechase0 to change mod's settings more comfortably. Or just change [b]config.json[/b] file in the mod's folder manually.﻿
[/list]
-------------------------------------------------
[b][b][color=#ffff00]Warning:[/color][/b]
[/b]This mod can and will conflict with any other mod that changes Leah's appearance. It will also conflict with mods that change spouse rooms or her cabin map. Just set mod's settings for edited rooms to "false" if you do not wish to use my version of them. So, pay attention, guys :)

-------------------------------------------------

[/b]

[url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/193933561-queensnw/]Queensnw[/url] was managing communication to get permissions for using the assets which I'm extremely grateful for! Initial edits for [b]festival portraits and sprites[/b] for this mod were also done by [url=https://forums.nexusmods.com/profile/193933561-queensnw/]Queensnw[/url]. I did further fixing and polishing of art, testing sprites and coding.
